question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 73 km/hr and 123 km/hr. The time taken by faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 27 seconds. What will be the length of the faster train?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the slower train = 73 km/hr

Speed of the faster train = 123 km/hr

Time taken by the faster train to cross a man in the slower train = 27 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of the faster train - Speed of the slower train

Length of the faster train = Relative Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = 123 km/hr - 73 km/hr

Relative Speed = 50 km/hr

Convert speed from km/hr to m/s:

1 km/hr = (5)/(18) m/s

Relative Speed = 50 × (5)/(18) m/s

Relative Speed = (250)/(18) m/s

Time = 27 seconds

Length of the faster train = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Length of the faster train = (250/18) × 27

⇒ Length of the faster train = 375 meters

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
